structuralFindings: Property is structured into four distinct booking units, each with its own rate table: (1) 'Cottages (1 to 4) & rooms at Mama Taa Villa', (2) 'Cottage 5, Borelius room, Honeymoon (Andersson) Room & Alex' House' (priced per person, presumably for individual rooms within these units, separate from Alex House's own exclusive-villa pricing), (3) 'Main House (Mama Tina) — Children & Singles only' (no adult-sharing rate; Single Room/Use and child rates only), and (4) Alex House as a private 4-bedroom villa (min 4 paying guests, max 8 pax) — referenced in a footnote but with NO explicit per-pax or per-villa rate printed on the page for Alex House itself as an exclusive unit (only its per-person room rate appears bundled in table 2's row). Flag this gap if Alex House exclusive-use pricing is requested — not found on this page.
Base plan is All-Inclusive (per the 'Included Items' list: soft drinks, beer, house wines, spirits, activities) — one of the more inclusive base plans seen in this batch.
Three named seasons: Mid (2 Mar-17 Oct & 3 Nov-18 Dec), High (7 Jan-1 Mar & 18 Oct-2 Nov), Christmas (19 Dec-10 Jan) — a Mid/High/Christmas trio rather than Peak/Shoulder/Green.

Two age-banded child rates (12-17 and 6-11) plus a distinct '3rd Child in third bed/extra bed' rate — three child pricing tiers, more granular than most properties in this batch. Children under 6 sharing are free of charge (stated in Additional Information, not in the main table).

'Kinondo Kwetu Specials' offer a stay-X-pay-Y discount ladder (5-for-4 Mid season, 6-for-5 during 21 Jul-31 Aug, 7-for-6 High season) plus a 50% Brides Discount for honeymoon couples (Mid/High season only, one person per couple) — these specials cannot combine with each other or any other discount, and are NOT valid during Christmas season.

Extensive Excluded Items list (non-commissionable) includes specific named excursions (Marine Park & Paradise Lost, PADI diving, deep sea fishing, cultural visits, massage, waterskiing, horse riding, sailing, Shimba Hills safari) and separately-priced airstrip transfers (Ukunda one-way $50/vehicle max pax; Mombasa Moi Intl one-way $135/vehicle max 4 pax) — these transfer fees are explicitly marked non-commissionable.
Property closes for the whole of May and approximately 21 June (June dates flexible/demand-based) — a confirmed closure window, not a gap in the source.
